visualization.name: RMSX Flipbook
visualization.help:
# What is RMSX Flipbook?
**RMSX Flipbook** is a Galaxy visualization for exploring RMSX flipbook manifests produced by RMSX/Flipbook workflows. It renders the structural frames stored in an `rmsx.json` dataset with the bundled **Molstar** 3D viewer, coloring each residue by its RMSX value.
After selecting a compatible dataset, you'll see an interactive 3D view where the frames are laid out side by side along a shared RMSX color scale, ready to rotate, rescale, and compare.
## Key Features
- **Frame Flipbook**: Lays out the manifest's structural frames side by side for direct comparison. - **RMSX Coloring**: Colors residues by their per-frame RMSX values using a selectable palette. - **Interactive Controls**: Adjust layout spacing, columns, color and radius scales, thickness, and rotation in real time. - **Molstar Rendering**: Draws each structure as a smooth putty representation powered by the bundled Molstar viewer.
To learn more about RMSX/Flipbook, see: [https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-39869-7](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-39869-7)
